summary: Bowhead Specialty Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K reporting amendments to its Quota Share Reinsurance Agreement and Insurance Trust Agreement with American Family Mutual Insurance Company, along with quarterly results and shareholder meeting outcomes. The amendments adjust termination thresholds, ceding commissions, and collateralization requirements. These are routine contractual modifications in the ordinary course of insurance operations, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other transformative event is disclosed. The filing is a standard current report on operational updates.
